title: Setup & The Builder Mindset
subtitle: Configuring the environment and committing to 60 days of shipping.
whatILearned: Successfully set up the development environment, linked all necessary accounts, and published the first 'hello world' declaration for the ABTalks challenge. Learned the importance of consistency over intensity.
learningObjectives: Initialize a Git repository and push to GitHub
Draft a public commitment on LinkedIn

title: Design Systems 101
subtitle: Building the foundational typography and color tokens.
whatILearned: Translated a Figma file into CSS variables. Understood how a robust design system prevents spaghetti CSS later. Implemented Syne and Manrope fonts effectively.
learningObjectives: Define CSS custom properties for a theme
Import and configure custom fonts in Next.js

title: Building the Landing Hero
subtitle: Crafting the perfect first impression with layout and spacing.
whatILearned: Successfully learned and applied the concepts from Day 3. Built the hero section of the landing page, focusing on responsive typography and subtle animations. It was challenging to get the mobile spacing right, but using flexbox made it manageable.

title: Routing and Layouts
subtitle: Setting up the App Router architecture.
whatILearned: Wrapped my head around Next.js 13+ App Router. Created the root layout and nested layouts for the dashboard. Understanding server vs client components was a major milestone.
learningObjectives: Differentiate between Server and Client components

title: State Management Basics
subtitle: Handling UI state with React hooks.
whatILearned: Implemented local state using useState for a complex form. Learned how to lift state up when multiple components need access to the same data.
learningObjectives: Lift state up to a common ancestor
Avoid common React dependency array bugs

title: The Global Theme Toggle
subtitle: Implementing dark and light modes.
whatILearned: Created a robust theme context that respects user system preferences and saves to local storage. Fixed hydration mismatch errors that occur when rendering theme-dependent UI.
learningObjectives: Interact with localStorage safely in Next.js

title: Building Reusable UI Components
subtitle: Extracting buttons, cards, and inputs.
whatILearned: Refactored duplicated UI code into generic, reusable components. Learned how to pass HTML attributes down using rest parameters in TypeScript.

title: Mocking API Data
subtitle: Creating robust JSON fixtures.
whatILearned: Designed realistic mock data schemas to unblock frontend development. Realized that good mock data makes UI design much easier.
learningObjectives: Import and type JSON data in TypeScript
Map over data to render lists

title: Dashboard Layout Grid
subtitle: Using CSS Grid for complex layouts.
whatILearned: Mastered CSS grid areas and responsive grid templates. Built the main dashboard structure that holds the activity grid and side panels.
learningObjectives: Use gap and fr units effectively
Make grids responsive without media queries using auto-fit

title: Interactive Data Visualizations
subtitle: Building the 60-Day Activity Grid.
whatILearned: Created a highly interactive component that maps status states to CSS variables. Handled hover states, click events, and dynamic rendering based on complex logic.
learningObjectives: Render a grid of dynamic data
Manage complex state for interactive elements
Ensure accessible contrast for all state colors

title: Polishing & Refactoring
subtitle: Cleaning up tech debt before the next big feature.
whatILearned: Took a step back to review code from days 1-10. Extracted hardcoded strings, optimized images, and fixed a few responsive layout bugs on mobile devices.
